messages.speaker: customer
messages.message: My order ACM-4521 has not arrived and it was due three days ago.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.message: Hello! I'm sorry your order is late. Let me check the tracking details for you.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.message: I have already contacted support twice about this. It's ridiculous that nobody has helped.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.message: I understand your frustration, and I apologise for the repeated contacts. The parcel is delayed at the local depot.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.message: I want a full refund today or I will cancel my account and file a complaint.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.message: I'm escalating this to a senior specialist now and will email you a refund confirmation within 24 hours.
